title: Recompose batch fabric and simplify KV lease lifecycle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Over time the continuous-batcher, lease manager, and KV cache read path have accreted special-case behaviors (hotkey heuristics, per-lane timers, and shadow eviction hooks). This has increased cognitive load, introduced bugs during high tail-latency workloads, and made kernel-selection heuristics brittle. Goal: recompose the 'batch fabric' (the orchestration layer that binds request lanes, prefetch logic, and commit/lease handoff) into a smaller set of well-specified primitives and simplify the KV lease lifecycle so warmups, renewals, and evictions follow a single contract. Targets: reduce p95 token latency variance by 15% under mixed short/long workloads, cut CPU overhead of batching controller by 20%, and eliminate one class of race observed during preemption. Scope: 1) Introduce a BatchFabric abstraction with clear enqueue/dequeue/prime/commit phases and a single lockless admission API. 2) Centralize lease transitions in a KVLeaseManager that exposes renew, release, and grace-period semantics and records metrics for state transitions. 3) Remove lane-specific timers and replace them with policy-driven backoff in the fabric. 4) Migrate legacy hotkey bypass to a pluggable admission filter with opt-in behavior per deployment tier. 5) Add integration tests that replay production traces (small/medium/large request mixes) to validate invariants and measure perf targets. Trade-offs: this is a sizable refactor with risk to latency SLOs during rollout; we will mitigate with canary rolling deployments, runtime flags to switch between old/new fabric, and thorough load testing. Compatibility: public APIs (request/response contract) unchanged; internal metrics labels will be versioned. Rolling plan: dev branch -> internal perf cluster -> canary on 10% of traffic (hosted) -> 50% -> full. Rollback: runtime flag to revert to legacy batcher. Observability: add metrics for batch_fabric.enqueue/ms, lease_manager.transition_count, eviction_reasons, and a debug trace for handoffs. Deliverables: design doc with sequence diagrams, runtime flag, migration PR, load test harness, postmortem checklist.
